steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Strain theory (Merton): society promotes cultural goals (especially material success) but does not provide equal access to legitimate means to achieve them. When people cannot achieve success legitimately, they experience strain. Five adaptations: conformity (accept goals and means), innovation (accept goals, use illegitimate means - e.g. theft), ritualism (abandon goals but follow means - e.g. dead-end job), retreatism (abandon both - e.g. drug addiction), rebellion (replace both with new goals - e.g. revolution). | Key Fact: Labelling theory (Becker): no act is inherently criminal - it becomes criminal only when labelled as such by society.
